spans.s: अद्, ii. 2, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm.

; to devour, 4, 28.
 स्वदित, i. e. सु-अदित, n. Well eaten, a term used after presenting food (‘muc good may it do you!’),

; 254.
 अद्य, Eatable, Pañc. iv. d. 79 (perhaps it ought to be changed to आद्य, the regular form).
 --Cf. ἔδω; Lat. edere; Goth. itan; A.S. etan.
-अद्, latter part of comp. words. One who eats, cf. क्रव्याद्.
